changes_made.explanation: Added Text-to-Image Generation as it's a major focus; expanded datasets and models to include all explicitly mentioned ones used in evaluations; normalized capitalization consistently

Added EMT and ATR which are discussed as toxicity metrics; removed redundant names (Inception Score = IS, Frechet Inception Distance = FID, Toxicity Probability = TP); normalized to base forms as per guidelines
No LLMs were used as judges for evaluation - the paper only uses LLMs for generation (like GPT-4 for LLaVA instruction tuning) but not for evaluation

guideline: Two annotators evaluated 50 randomly sampled generations in pairwise comparison
Annotators compared original vs detoxified generations and labeled as win/lose/tie
Score=1 indicates lower toxicity/higher quality or comparable

overall_notes: The paper focuses on toxicity evaluation and detoxification for visual-language generation models across both image captioning (I2T) and text-to-image generation (T2I) tasks. The extraction was generally good but missed several important models and datasets used in the evaluations. The paper uses extensive automatic evaluation and includes human evaluation with clear protocols.
